name: @epoch/actualization-runtime
description: Epoch Actualization Runtime service (W039): the thin typed HOST FACADE over @epoch/actualization + @epoch/variance — delivery-record registration (idempotent by digest), observation intake through the ObservationSourcePort adapter seam (ONE in-memory reference adapter; the core never names a vendor) and through direct calls with IDEMPOTENT replay (same record -> duplicate-observation admission, state unchanged), typed validation assessment + conflict-resolution admission, actualization application EXCLUSIVELY through the W036 DeliveryRecord authority path (recordObservation -> acceptObservation -> actualizeObservation — never a direct actual write), variance computation + evidence-grounded root-cause attribution, rolling forecast revision emission (append-only W036 Forecast-distinction records refining earlier forecasts only), immutable comparison-fact admission with calibration folds, and the derived actualization-state projection. Every step emits actualization:* events (W010-shaped, one stream per delivery stream:actualization-<suffix>) sealed by the kernel and pinned by REAL sealEvent parity tests. The W009 authorization gate denies unauthorized operations BEFORE any kernel admission; tenant isolation is typed tenant-isolation-rejected. In-memory reference behavior: NO persistence, NO network, NO real observation sources; core logic stays pure (zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied).
